baseline.scope:
Offline road geometry benchmark using existing decoded map-cell files.

Measures the road builder and draped mesh separately, with flat 10 m terrain.
This deliberately excludes network, grading, buildings, process queues and game
imports. The input cache is read only; profiles and JSON go to --out.

diagnostics.scope: deterministic reproductions, no network and no runtime performance estimate

cold_worker.scope: One sequential three-tile run per version, fresh independent raw-data snapshots, no cProfile, offline, seven faults on each first tile. Diagnostic only; no complete-world acceptance.

cold_start_followup.scope: Three sequential A/B pairs with fresh spawned workers and raw-only caches, no revisit products or network. Imports/init outside timer; OS file cache not flushed. Incomplete snapshot, no game/FPS acceptance.

trace.scope: Instrumented attribution only. Inclusive/exclusive wall time aggregates overlapping threads, not CPU time; no A/B claim from these timings.

lane_input_followup.scope: Three sequential A/B pairs; same offline raw snapshot and fresh spawned workers. Imports/init outside timer; OS file cache not flushed; no game/FPS claim. Trial IDs 3-5 use final implementation, earlier prototypes excluded.

before.scope:
Compare lane preparation with raw input decoding outside the timed region.

Each pass starts with fresh Features and caches, then solves nine neighbouring
home cells through lane_flow. Up to 7x7 source cells cover their dependencies.
Missing offline cells stay absent. No network or writes to the source cache.
